leads.summary: Builds RPCA, a C2PA-conformant content-provenance validator and generator that lets people inspect Content Credentials and manifests on media files.
leads.hook: The live verify page reads the C2PA manifest from a dropped file and shows who signed it, a concrete check rather than a score.
leads.angle_reason: RPCA is a deterministic validator that parses a structured manifest and reports what it finds, the same kind of work as Canopy's deterministic call-graph resolution.

leads.summary: Software development company building custom web, mobile and AI solutions for UK and US businesses, and running its own products TinTorch and Lattice.casa.
leads.hook: Its Lattice.casa product says it maps 14,300 sites and 2.8M relationships into a knowledge graph.
leads.angle_reason: Lattice.casa builds a graph of relationships between entities, the same graph-building work as Canopy's cross-file call graph.

leads.summary: Healthcare financing platform in India with product lines for families, hospitals, pharma and wellness brands, including Swasth and Procalyx.
leads.hook: eHealth Magazine reported on October 7 that AffordPlan raised $10 million, and its site runs separate products for families, hospitals and pharma.
leads.angle_reason: A funded health-tech company handling patient-facing healthcare data and payments matches MedVault's health-tech, Django backend and JWT auth work.

leads.summary: Enterprise AI assistant platform whose pre-built AI Colleagues answer employee HR, IT and finance questions over back-office systems, used by 500+ enterprises.

leads.angle_reason: The product is an LLM answering questions over an organisation's private documents with per-user access, which is what MedVault's grounded pipeline and per-user isolation do.

leads.summary: Runs an IoT project and training website that publishes Raspberry Pi, Arduino and NodeMCU tutorials and project guides.
leads.hook: Its 2026 posts cover AI plant disease detection on Raspberry Pi with TensorFlow Lite and driver drowsiness detection with OpenCV and dlib.
leads.angle_reason: Weak match: the site is tutorial content on embedded and vision projects, and Canopy is code-analysis tooling, so only the shared Python focus connects them.

leads.summary: Tech recruitment company that sources, assesses and screens engineers for client companies using its own proctored assessment platform.
leads.hook: Its site describes an in-house proctored assessment platform with recorded video interviews and skill-based candidate reports.
leads.angle_reason: Its assessments evaluate candidate code, which loosely resembles Canopy's static analysis, but the company is a staffing firm and not a product fit.
red_flags: staffing agency: sources and pre-validates candidates for client companies
